description: Use when an agent already has a URL and needs the page as clean Markdown (boilerplate removed, tables kept). Input: url, optional max_chars (500-60000), flags=1 for rule-based prompt-injection signals. Output: JSON markdown, title, language, finalUrl, chars, truncated. SSRF-safe; pages opting out with noai are refused. English brief: /v1/web/read/brief. Search+read: /v1/web/search-read. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

flags.description: 1 = add rule-based prompt-injection signals found in the page

name: web_read
title: Web read: one URL to clean Markdown for LLMs (title, language, optional injection flags)
